plugin.name: ToDesk Remote
plugin.description: Connect this computer to another one by its ToDesk device code, straight from the panel or from the conversation. The agent reads the code, opens sessions and can keep this machine reachable — no ToDesk setting has to be found first.
view.label: ToDesk
view.description: This machine's code, and a connect box.
local.launchError: ToDesk's command line could not be started: {{error}}
local.commandDenied: The host has not granted this plugin the ToDesk.exe command. Allow it once in Settings → Plugins → ToDesk → commands, then press Refresh.
local.autostart.title: Start with Windows
local.autostart.on: On — the client returns after a reboot.
local.autostart.off: Off — after a reboot nobody can connect until someone opens ToDesk.
local.autostart.failed: Could not change the autostart setting.
connect.title: Connect to another computer
connect.hint: Type the far side's device code. ToDesk asks for the password itself.
connect.sent: Handed to ToDesk: connecting to {{id}}. Accept it in the ToDesk window and work there.
connect.sent.withPassword: Sent to ToDesk: connecting to {{id}} with the password you typed.
connect.password.hint: Only for a device you already unlocked in your device list. Otherwise leave this empty and the client asks for it.
inbound.summary: To come in from a phone or another computer, give them this code; the password is the one ToDesk shows on this machine. Download: {{url}}
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.host.title: Host command grant
diag.host.granted: ToDesk.exe is allowed by the host.
diag.host.missing: ToDesk.exe is not granted by the host yet — allow it in Settings → Plugins → ToDesk → commands.
diag.agent.title: Agent capabilities
diag.agent.body: Each one can be switched off; the host still has to grant ToDesk.exe for any of them to run.
diag.tools.status.name: todesk_status
diag.tools.status: device code, version, autostart, running state
diag.tools.connect.name: todesk_connect
diag.tools.connect: open a session by device code
diag.tools.autostart.name: todesk_autostart
diag.tools.open.name: todesk_open_client
connect.screen: The picture opens in ToDesk's own window — this panel starts the session, it does not mirror it.
connect.disconnected: ToDesk client closed — every session it held is gone. Use Open ToDesk to bring it back.
connect.disconnect.failed: Could not close the ToDesk client
session.hint: The picture is in ToDesk's window. Disconnecting closes the client, which is the only way its CLI ends a session.
session.ended.hint: Nothing is connected from this panel now.
diag.tools.disconnect.name: todesk_disconnect
connect.needPassword: Enter the password ToDesk shows on that machine.
device.password.title: Temporary password
device.password.body: Shown in ToDesk's own window on this computer; it rotates, so read it there when someone needs it.
